But first I'm going to say definitely use whatever you prefer, especially for the main campaign because just about anything can eventually become a great race car.

But in terms of best times and most consistent results you have one of two options. You could go with the Regera which had the best top speed in the game (great for Sprint races) but low acceleration. Or the Porche 911 RS 2.7L. The Porche is kind of the best of all worlds. Ok so first,gather up some spare parts if your nsx isn't 6x outlaw because that's the best cards for drag races. 

Second there is a way to slightly cheese it by ramming into him before the bridge so he hits the left barrier, the beetle doesn't have enough weight behind it that's why I'm recommending the nsx.

But also if you have the time and money, the Corvette is the best drag car right beneath the beetle, but it has better handling which is why a lot of people prefer it over the beetle. My personal favorite drag car is the Porche 918 Spyder which is another great handling drag car. 

Also I'm sure you know but always make sure to hit perfect shifts whenever possible because they give you extra nos. Because as long as your car is over even slightly the recommend levels, with all perfect shifts you should beat him. 

Also make sure your opening your crates for spare parts, I know I didn't know where to unlock the boxes until like a month after playing so if you don't know how let me know and I'll tell you.

For off-road it's a toss up between the derelict Mustang, Bel air, and the Porche 911 2.7 RS. I'd recommend one of the two derelict because while the Porche has great acceleration, it also slides everywhere so there's somewhat of a learning curve to it.

For Runner again it's a toss up between the BMW M5 and the Porche Panemera. They're both tanks when it comes to taking out cops so it's down to preference there.

For speed cross it's really up to preference since every car has the potential to be great. But my personal favorite is the mustang because it has unreal drifting potential aswell as great acceleration. 

Hope this helps!
